_comment: Minimal SONiC database_config.json for the benchmark harness.
The Python daemon reaches STATE_DB through swsscommon.Table, which requires
SonicDBConfig to resolve db ids and separators. The Rust daemon does not need this
file -- RealDbTable addresses rows by explicit composite key over a DbConnector -- so
this exists purely to give the two daemons the SAME backing store.
Ids and separators must match xcvrd-rs/src/env.rs (STATE_DB 6, CONFIG_DB 4, APPL_DB 0)
and RealDbTable's separator handling: '|' for STATE_DB/CONFIG_DB, ':' for APPL_DB.
Point swsscommon at this with SONIC_DB_CONFIG_FILE rather than installing it into
/var/run/redis/sonic-db/, so the harness needs no privileged paths.
